title: 按键：一个能合上的缺口
summary: 开关就是电路里的一个缺口：松开时断开，按下时接通。先用万用表看它，再让它控制 LED。
concepts: open / closed 断开 / 接通
description: 四脚按键横跨凹槽：同一侧的两只脚一直相通，按下时左右两侧才接通。电路：+5 V → 按键 → 220 Ω → 红色 LED → GND。松开时 LED 灭，按下时亮。

cards.title: 按下去，看表
text: 先放一个按键，在它输出那一侧放上万用表的红表笔。**单击按键**按下、再单击松开，盯着读数。
松开和按下时，读数各是什么？

cards.title: 开关 = 能合上的缺口
text: - 开关就是电路里一个**可以合上的缺口**。松开：缺口张开，没有电流（**断开**）；按下：缺口合上，像一根导线（**接通**）。
![](fig:switch)
- 松开时，第 7 列什么都没连上，万用表显示**悬空**：它不是 0 V，只是没有确定的电压。
- 四脚按键横跨凹槽放：**同一列的上下两只脚本来就通**（第 5 列一对、第 7 列一对），按下时第 5 列和第 7 列才接通。
![](fig:legs)

cards.title: 让按键控制 LED
text: 在按键的输出（第 7 列下半段）后面接电阻和 LED，回到下方的 − 轨。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 开关**串**在要控制的那条路上：它断开，整条路就断了。
- 悬空的点不是 0 V。以后接单片机时，没接东西的输入脚会“乱读”，要用上拉、下拉电阻给它一个确定的电压（第 5 世界）。
- 真实按键按下的瞬间会**抖动**几毫秒（接通、断开好几次）。点灯看不出来，但单片机能数出好几次按下——这个以后再解决。

caption.text: 按键就是一个缺口：松开时断开，没有电流；按下时合上，像一根导线。

i18n.en: A pushbutton is a gap: released it is open and no current flows; pressed it closes like a wire.

caption.text: 四脚按键跨在凹槽上：第 5 列上下两只脚本来就通，第 7 列也是；按下时 5 列和 7 列才连起来。

i18n.en: The four-leg button straddles the trench: its two column-5 legs are always joined, so are the column-7 legs; pressing it joins column 5 to column 7.

en.title: Push buttons: a gap you can close
en.summary: A switch is a gap in the circuit: open when released, closed when pressed. Watch it with the multimeter first, then let it control an LED.
en.description: A four-pin push button straddles the trench: the two pins on the same side are always connected, and pressing joins the two sides. Circuit: +5 V → button → 220 Ω → red LED → GND. Released, the LED is off; pressed, it is on.
steps: **Breadboard power module** in **`tp1`**, keep **5 V**: all four rails are powered.
Red **jumper** **`tp5`** → **`a5`**: the top half of column 5 = +5 V.
**Push button** at **`e5`**, across the trench: its four pins are in e5, e7, f5 and f7. Column 5 is the input, column 7 the output.
Pick **Multimeter** and put the red probe on **`h7`** (the lower half of the output column). Then **click the button** to press it, click again to release, and watch the reading.
**R1** (**`220 Ω`**) from the lower half of column 7: **`h7`** – **`h11`**.
**Red LED**: long lead **`i11`**, short lead **`i14`**; blue **jumper** **`j14`** → **`bn14`** (the lower − rail).
Click the button: pressed → LED on, released → off. Then press **Check my circuit**.
hints: The button straddles the trench in the middle, with its pins on both sides.
The output is column 7: the resistor starts from column 7, not column 5.

cards.title: Press it and watch the meter
text: Place a button and put the multimeter's red probe on its output side. **Click the button** to press it, click again to release, and watch the reading.
What does it read released, and what pressed?

cards.title: A switch = a gap you can close
text: - A switch is **a gap in the circuit that you can close**. Released, the gap is open and no current flows (**open**); pressed, it closes and acts like a wire (**closed**).
![](fig:switch)
- Released, column 7 is connected to nothing, so the multimeter shows **floating**: not 0 V, just no defined voltage at all.
- A four-pin button straddles the trench: **the two pins in the same column are always connected** (a pair in column 5, a pair in column 7); pressing joins column 5 to column 7.
![](fig:legs)

cards.title: Let the button control an LED
text: After the button's output (the lower half of column 7) add the resistor and the LED, back to the lower − rail.

cards.title: Take away
text: - A switch goes **in series** with what it controls: open the switch and the whole path is open.
- A floating point is not 0 V. Later, a microcontroller input left unconnected reads garbage; pull-up and pull-down resistors give it a defined voltage (World 5).

- A real button **bounces** for a few milliseconds when pressed (closing and opening several times). You cannot see it on an LED, but a microcontroller can count several presses — a problem for later.

measurements.ask: In step 4 (before the resistor), with the button released, what does the multimeter show on column 7?
choices: Floating: nothing is connected to column 7, so it has no defined voltage
measurements.explain: With the button open, column 7 is cut off from the supply, and nothing else connects it to GND — so it floats.

measurements.ask: Press the button and click the LED: the current in Properties
measurements.explain: (5 − 1.8) / (220 + 12) ≈ 13.8 mA. A closed button has almost no resistance.

measurements.ask: 在第 4 步（还没接电阻时），松开按键，万用表在第 7 列上显示什么？
choices: 悬空：第 7 列什么都没连，没有确定的电压
measurements.explain: 按键断开时第 7 列和电源断开，又没有别的元件把它接到 GND，所以它是悬空的。

measurements.ask: 按下按键，单击 LED：「属性」里的电流

steps.text: **面包板电源模块**插 **`tp1`**，保持 **5 V**：上下四条轨都有电了。
**按键**放在 **`e5`**，横跨凹槽：四只脚在 e5、e7、f5、f7。第 5 列是输入端，第 7 列是输出端。
选**「万用表」**，红表笔点 **`h7`**（输出端的下半段）。然后**单击按键**按下、再单击松开，看读数怎么变。
单击按键试试：按下 → LED 亮，松开 → 灭。然后点**「检查我的电路」**。

hints: 按键要横跨中间的凹槽，四只脚分别在凹槽两边。
输出端是第 7 列：电阻要从第 7 列出发，而不是第 5 列。
